resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and French source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded French pass identified 25 actionable false-friend, grammar, register, thermal, circuit, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent French human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The power paragraph translated heat-dissipation capability as thermal capacity and free space.
evidence: The previous text used capacité thermique et espace libre.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with capacité de dissipation thermique and a marge de sécurité.

findings.summary: The heating-power heading used a less precise heating term.
evidence: The previous title was Puissance de chauffage.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Puissance thermique.

findings.summary: The coil setup used transporte for electrical current.
evidence: The previous setup was Une bobine de 0,8 Ω transporte 3 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a coil conducting a 3 A current.

findings.summary: The heading was an awkward literal question about heating.
evidence: The previous title was Qu'est-ce qui affecte le chauffage.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Facteurs qui influencent le chauffage.

findings.summary: The paragraph needed the more precise areal heat-flow term and clearer surface-transfer wording.
evidence: The previous text used flux thermique and described heat leaving the surface.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with densité de flux thermique and natural French.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph translated safety margin as physical clearance.
evidence: The previous text used espace libre adéquat.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with marge de sécurité suffisante.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor conclusion used transporte for current through a branch.
evidence: The previous text was chaque branche transporte 10 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a 10 A current circulating in each branch.

findings.summary: The cell heading could state the connection relationship more naturally.
evidence: The previous title was Cellules en série et en parallèle.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Cellules connectées en série et en parallèle.

findings.summary: The series-cell bullet used an unclear equivalent-cell phrase.
evidence: The previous text ended with celle d'une cellule identique.
findings.resolution: Changed it to celle d'une cellule équivalente.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning used an awkward literal phrase for series charging.
evidence: The previous text was La charge des ions lithium en série.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as series charging of lithium-ion cells with per-cell monitoring.

findings.summary: The triangle explanation needed clearer and less repetitive definitions of the sides and SOH-CAH-TOA.
evidence: The previous paragraph used au-dessus de l'hypoténuse and similar literal phrasing.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with precise opposite, adjacent, hypotenuse, sine, cosine, and tangent definitions.

findings.summary: The setup used rencontre un angle, which is not a meaningful geometric relation.
evidence: The previous setup was Une hypoténuse de 10 cm rencontre un angle de 30°.
findings.resolution: Changed it to state that the hypotenuse is opposite a 30° angle.

findings.summary: The worked-example title used an unnatural literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Eau de chauffage.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Exemple de chauffage de l'eau.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity conclusion used vrai radiateur, which is not the intended generic real heater.
evidence: The previous text said un vrai radiateur a besoin de plus.
findings.resolution: Changed it to un chauffage réel en nécessite davantage.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating heading was longer and less idiomatic than necessary.
evidence: The previous title was Chauffage à l'énergie électrique.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Chauffage électrique.

findings.summary: The object/material heading used contre, which sounds adversarial rather than comparative.
evidence: The previous title was Objet contre matériau.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Objet et matériau.

findings.summary: The paragraph used appartient à l'objet rather than a clearer technical reference.
evidence: The previous text began La capacité thermique appartient à l’objet entier.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with se rapporte à l'objet entier and natural grammar.

findings.summary: The heat-flux definition heading did not make the per-area density explicit.
evidence: The previous title was Définition.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Définition de la densité de flux thermique.

findings.summary: The definition bullet called q'' simply heat flux instead of heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous text was q'' est le flux thermique.
findings.resolution: Changed it to q'' est la densité de flux thermique.

findings.summary: The radiation paragraph used an inconsistent space in Stefan–Boltzmann and singular kelvin.
evidence: The previous text used Stefan – Boltzmann and températures absolues en kelvin.
findings.resolution: Standardized Stefan-Boltzmann and changed the unit wording to kelvins.

findings.summary: The practical check used an infinitive fragment instead of a direct instruction.
evidence: The previous bullet began Distinguer le flux thermique moyen.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the formal instruction Distinguez.

findings.summary: The final practical check also used an infinitive instead of an instruction.
evidence: The previous bullet ended utiliser la capacité thermique.
findings.resolution: Changed it to utilisez la capacité thermique and clarified temperature changes.

findings.summary: The TCR conclusion omitted the customary space before the percentage sign.
evidence: The previous text used 3,2% au-dessus.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 3,2 % au-dessus.

findings.summary: The wire specification bullet translated current capacity as capacité actuelle.
evidence: The previous text used Déterminez la capacité actuelle.
findings.resolution: Changed it to capacité de courant.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge heading used jauge, which is less consistent with the locale's established calibre terminology.
evidence: The previous title was Systèmes de jauge.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Systèmes de calibres.
